questions: Does the operation allow swapping any occurrence of a with any occurrence of b, or only specific ones (e.g., the first occurrence of each)?
Can the operation be performed on the same couple more than once in the sequence of swaps?
Must the swaps be performed only between the two couples a and b, or can other couples' positions be involved indirectly?
Is the goal to have both couples adjacent simultaneously in the final state, or just each couple adjacent at some point (possibly different times)?
Are we allowed to swap positions that are not currently occupied by a or b, or is the operation strictly limited to swapping an a with a b?
Does the operation require that the swapped positions i and j are distinct, or can they be the same (i.e., no-op)?
Should the count include pairs (a, b) where the couples are already adjacent initially but we still consider swapping to make them adjacent again?
Is the sequence of swaps allowed to be infinite, or must it terminate in a finite number of steps?
